payload.title: TI P4-05: template: host under a shared root domain and an explicit staging host
payload.description:
## Goal
A NEW Threat Intelligence CMS app (WEB_COMPUTE, Pretext public site + /newsroom in one app) created from the template, connected to the repo with the Amplify GitHub App, first build green on its default amplifyapp.com URL, release-gate checks passed. No domain yet. Mirrors Pilobol.us P3-04 (PPY-97f03c) minus the reader app: a Pretext site has no separate reader app (examples/pretext.site.json has no reader block).

## Context (FACT)
- Pilobol lessons (docs/site-hosting.md, "Verify and repair after connecting"): the console GitHub connect can flip platform to WEB, replace the service role with amplifyconsole-backend-role, and DELETE the stack's branches and their environment variables (observed 2026-10-06). Repair: update-app --platform WEB_COMPUTE and --iam-service-role-arn; re-create branches; re-apply env vars by a stack update that changes the branch variables (CloudFormation does not see the loss as drift).
- Prereqs: scaffold PR merged into the TI repo main (P4-04), template change merged and published (P4-05), an @anthusai/papyrus next version containing both pins.
- The new Cognito domain prefix papyrus-threat-intelligence must differ from the old pool's auto-generated domain b1f1d3a11a4545ba5318 (old pool us-east-1_lAtce7ZTu stays until retire).
- Release gates to check from the Pilobol list: schema gate (new backend has bodyMarkus, bodyIr, aliases on Item and PublishedItem); brand gate (unknown brand id fails a scratch build; PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND and NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND equal threat-intelligence); nodejs middleware works on WEB_COMPUTE (pages, /newsroom, robots).
- Secrets exist today as SSM params under /amplify/d3on1y5vlrxmam/main-branch-aeb7dfa526/: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET (the JWT authorizer was removed from develop; the new backend uses IAM, so PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET is not recreated).

## Exact steps
1. Ryan: aws sso login --profile legacy; yes to deploying the new stack (npx papyrus-infra synth, review cdk diff, cdk deploy from infra/ with AWS_PROFILE=legacy). Record AppId output.
2. Ryan, console sitting: install the AWS Amplify GitHub App on AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence (add the repository to the existing org install), connect the new app to repository AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence branch main using the template's existing service role, no new role.
3. Run aws amplify get-app and list-branches before and after; apply the repairs above if drifted; re-deploy the stack to re-apply branch env vars; start the first build; wait for the backend pipeline-deploy and frontend build to succeed.
4. Gate checks (read-only probes and a scratch build): the three gates above; GET the default URL home (redirects to the edition path), /newsroom, and a missing path returns the 404 page.
5. Record names of env vars only (never values).

## Acceptance checks
- aws amplify get-app shows platform WEB_COMPUTE, the template service role, repository AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence; list-branches shows main with the env var NAMES from site.json plus SITE_ENV, PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND, PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE.
- Job status SUCCEED for branch main; new AppSync API exists with the schema gate satisfied; new Cognito pool has domain papyrus-threat-intelligence.
- The default URL serves the Pretext site shell (empty edition acceptable until P4-09) and /newsroom.
- Old app untouched (list-jobs unchanged, still serving).

## Rollback
Delete the new stack (Ryan deletes); the old app is unaffected.

## Risks
Python 3.12 on Amplify is not needed for a Pretext cms spec (it only runs npm and ampx), so the Pilobol risk does not apply here; the backend build still bundles Python Lambdas from papyrus-newsroom==<pin> and is first exercised here. Build compute: the old app needed no special size; Pilobol used STANDARD_8GB (cms.buildComputeType).

## Needs Ryan
Yes: SSO login, stack deploy yes, console GitHub App sitting (step 2).

## Common rules (Phase 4 Threat Intelligence)
- Plan and facts: the assessment comment on the Phase 4 ticket (PPY-332889). Pattern: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md and docs/standard-site.md 3.2 on origin/develop.
- Ryan: Threat Intelligence is PRE-PRODUCTION; goal is to dogfood the new backend CMS UX before converting anth.us (production). Treat as a hard cutover with brief downtime accepted unless Ryan says otherwise (open question Q1). The OLD app d3on1y5vlrxmam and its backend stay untouched and serving until the retire ticket.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan or on his explicit yes. Read-only AWS calls are fine.
- NEVER use /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us as a build dir. TI repo work: fresh clone under /Users/home/Projects/ (delete afterwards), feature branch + PR, never push to its main. Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus (the board checkout) only run kbs; never git add or commit there.
- Gherkin first for any Papyrus behavior change (AGENTS.md). Long clear names, no line-level comments.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.
